newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Bank Tiara considers merger.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Bank Tiara considers merger.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Bank Tiara Asia said on Tuesday it is open to a merger with any other medium-sized bank which focuses on consumer banking.
"If the merger gives added value to our shareholders, why not," Bank Tiara's senior financial executive K.J. Low told Reuters. He added however that no deals were in sight.
Low said the bank kept the option for a merger open particularly with another bank with the same market focus.

"To achieve significant added value and economies of scale we have to find a medium-sized bank whose focus is the same as ours. As you know our focus is on the middle market segment and consumer banking," Low said.
Bank Tiara, a medium-size bank, had been approached by some smaller private-owned banks to merge but there had been no deals, he said.
Bank Tiara posted a net profit of 17.55 billion rupiah in the first-half of 1996 against 14.91 billion rupiah in the same period of last year.
